notes.title: Massive Update: Graphics, Gameplay & Enhanced Content!
notes.notes: [p][/p][h3]🎨 Graphics & Atmosphere[/h3][list][*][p]Completely reworked cats, enemies, and environments[/p][/*][*][p]New visual effects for attacks, artifacts, and environments[/p][/*][*][p]10 different, more immersive and stylish environments[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ Redesigned gameplay[/h3][list][*][p][b]The Wheel spins endlessly: improve damage, speed, earn diamonds, and more.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Place up to 3 cats in battle.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Each cat has a unique attack to target specific enemies.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]💎 Economy & progression[/h3][list][*][p]Cats can be purchased with Purple Orbs (from bosses, resale of cats, or exchanged for diamonds)[/p][/*][*][p]30 playable cats, each fully upgradeable[/p][/*][*][p]30 enemy types and 10 bosses, unlocked throughout the game[/p][/*][/list][h3]🗝️ Artifacts & Strategy[/h3][list][*][p]Artifacts to obtain: very rare on enemies, more common on bosses.[/p][/*][*][p]They offer bonuses: increased attack, attack speed, extra cat, and more.[/p][/*][*][p]Think about your combos: cat + artifact = optimized build.[/p][/*][/list][p]This update greatly enriches the experience: more control, strategy, and visual and playful challenges. 👉 The bosses from the trailer are here, and more will be added gradually.[/p][p]Thank you for your feedback and support!
